// VARIANT 1: HttpClientTestingModule — Service Integration Regression
// =============================================================================
// Use for: @Injectable services with HTTP calls
// Dependencies: @angular/common/http/testing (included with Angular)
// =============================================================================

import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { HttpClientTestingModule, HttpTestingController } from '@angular/common/http/testing';

import { {{CLASS_NAME}} } from './{{FILE_NAME}}';

// {{OPTIONAL_REQUIREMENT_TAG}} // @requirement {{REQUIREMENT_ID}}
describe('Regression: {{CLASS_NAME}} integration — {{CHANGE_DESCRIPTION}}', () => {

  let service: {{CLASS_NAME}};
  let httpMock: HttpTestingController;

  beforeEach(() => {
    TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      imports: [HttpClientTestingModule],
      providers: [{{CLASS_NAME}}]
    });
    service = TestBed.inject({{CLASS_NAME}});
    httpMock = TestBed.inject(HttpTestingController);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    httpMock.verify();
  });

  describe('{{IMPACTED_METHOD}} — HTTP integration', () => {

    it('should still make correct API request', () => {
      // service.{{IMPACTED_METHOD}}(input).subscribe(result => {
      //   expect(result).toBeTruthy();
      // });
      //
      // const req = httpMock.expectOne('{{API_ENDPOINT}}');
      // expect(req.request.method).toBe('{{HTTP_METHOD}}');
      // expect(req.request.body).toEqual(expectedBody);
      // req.flush(mockResponse);
    });

    it('should still handle error responses correctly', () => {
      // service.{{IMPACTED_METHOD}}(input).subscribe({
      //   error: (err) => {
      //     expect(err.status).toBe({{ERROR_STATUS}});
      //   }
      // });
      //
      // const req = httpMock.expectOne('{{API_ENDPOINT}}');
      // req.flush('Error', { status: {{ERROR_STATUS}}, statusText: '{{ERROR_TEXT}}' });
    });
  });

  describe('{{IMPACTED_METHOD}} — response structure', () => {

    it('should still parse response with all required fields', () => {
      // service.{{IMPACTED_METHOD}}().subscribe(result => {

      // });

      // req.flush({ id: 1, name: 'Test', email: 'test@example.com' });

});
